name: [Dulcy Reply Agent] Dulcy approved sender v4

parameters.content:
# Dulcy Reply Agent V1 - Approval Sender

Only sends records where **Dulcy Reply Agent Human Action** is Approve Draft or Send Edited Reply.

It locks the record, checks the EmailBison thread for a newer inbound reply, sends, then writes an audit event.

Keep inactive until the intake workflow passes synthetic tests.

parameters.name: filterByFormula
parameters.value: AND({Dulcy Reply Agent Workspace Record ID}='recJx0WwHsdsvcVIN',AND({Reply Ownership}!='Handoff',NOT({DNC}),NOT({Client Handling}),OR({Dulcy Reply Agent State}='Approved',{Dulcy Reply Agent State}='Needs Approval'),OR({Dulcy Reply Agent Human Action}='Approve Draft',{Dulcy Reply Agent Human Action}='Send Edited Reply'),OR({Dulcy Reply Agent Due At}=BLANK(),IS_BEFORE({Dulcy Reply Agent Due At},NOW()))))

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({fields:{'Dulcy Reply Agent State':'Sending','Dulcy Reply Agent Attempt Count':$json.attempt,'Dulcy Reply Agent Updated At':new Date().toISOString()},typecast:true}) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const source=$('Parse Send Result').first().json;
return [{json:{eventBody:{records:[{fields:{'Event Key':'send:'+source.recordId+':'+source.attempt,'Email Record ID':source.recordId,'Workspace Record ID':source.workspaceRecordId,'Reply ID':source.replyId,'Event Type':source.sent?'Sent':source.accepted?'State Changed':'Failed','Intent':source.fields['Dulcy Reply Agent Intent']||'Other','State':source.state,'Actor':'Human','Occurred At':new Date().toISOString(),'Summary':source.sent?'Reply sent through EmailBison':source.reason,'Payload JSON':JSON.stringify(source.response).slice(0,90000),'Error':source.accepted?'':JSON.stringify(source.response).slice(0,9000)}}],typecast:false}}}];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({fields:{'Dulcy Reply Agent State':'Needs Approval','Dulcy Reply Agent Human Action':'None','Dulcy Reply Agent Last Error':'A newer inbound reply arrived before this draft was sent. Review the newest thread.','Dulcy Reply Agent Updated At':new Date().toISOString()},typecast:true}) }}

parameters.name: filterByFormula
parameters.value: ={{ "AND({Dulcy Reply Agent Workspace Record ID}='" + $('Prepare Send').first().json.workspaceRecordId + "',LOWER({Leads Email})='" + $('Prepare Send').first().json.leadEmail.toLowerCase().replace(/'/g,"\'") + "',{Courtesy Reply Sent At}!=BLANK())" }}

parameters.jsCode: const source=$('Prepare Send').first().json;const f=source.fields||{};const action=f['Dulcy Reply Agent Human Action'];if(!['Approve Draft','Send Edited Reply'].includes(action))return [];const body=String((action==='Send Edited Reply'?f['Custom Reply']:f['Dulcy Reply Agent Draft'])||'').trim();const prospect=String(f['Latest Reply']||'').trim();if(!body||!prospect)return [];if(!source.workspaceRecordId||!source.recordId||!source.replyId)throw new Error('Approved example needs a client, email record and original reply ID.');if(f.DNC===true||f['Dulcy Reply Agent Intent']==='Do Not Contact')return [];const intent=String(f['Dulcy Reply Agent Intent']||'');const situation=intent==='Not Interested'?'Not Interested':['Out of Office','Referred','Check Back Later'].includes(intent)?'Out of Office':'Interested';return [{json:{body:{performUpsert:{fieldsToMergeOn:['Source']},records:[{fields:{'Example':'Approved inbox reply: '+(source.leadName||source.leadEmail||source.recordId),'Workspace Record ID':source.workspaceRecordId,'Email Record ID':source.recordId,'Situation':situation,'Prospect Message':prospect,'AI Draft':String(f['Dulcy Reply Agent Draft']||''),'Approved Reply':body,'Feedback':String(f['Reply Feedback']||'').trim(),'Review Status':'Approved','Source':'Inbox approval: '+source.workspaceRecordId+':'+source.recordId+':'+source.replyId,'Updated At':new Date().toISOString()}}],typecast:true}}}];

parameters.query: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO dulcy_reply_agent.send_jobs(job_key,conversation_key,workspace_record_id,airtable_record_id,execution_id,draft_fingerprint,state,approved_snapshot) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,md5($6),'claimed',$7::jsonb) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING job_key) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS acquired;

parameters.jsCode: if($json.error||$json.fields?.['Dulcy Reply Agent State']!=='Sending')throw Error('Sending state write failed; claim retained for review');return [{json:$('Build EmailBison Send').first().json}];

parameters.query: UPDATE dulcy_reply_agent.send_jobs SET state=$3,provider_message_id=NULLIF($4,''),reason=$5,updated_at=now() WHERE job_key=$1 AND execution_id=$2 RETURNING job_key;

parameters.jsCode: if(!$json.job_key)throw Error('Ledger confirmation missing; no retry');return [{json:$('Parse Send Result').first().json}];
